description: Metrics 2.5.1 Slice M — base valid preflight request for one explicitly dated market-day shadow run. Deterministic static evidence (no wall clock / no network). The engine `config` and the pinned `expected` hashes are injected/derived by the test from the real config bytes; this fixture pins only the dated inputs (marketDate, source dates, universe). Source dates are as-of the market-day close (prices/volumes == marketDate); fundamentals lag is allowed (<= marketDate).
